reason: All seven poses are state-matched across BEFORE/PINNED and both repeats (same HUD values, camera and object positions). I found no action, debris or animation mismatch. AFTER moves toward the Unreal L9 panels (far-right of the source board, right column of the full board). Crushed charcoal floors lift to neutral blue-grey shade and warm khaki lit ground. Grid, crater warp, facet separation and contact shadows survive. Accents saturate rather than wash out, and no new flat or clipped highlight appears. Beyond tone, three changes are genuine readability gains: bolder dark-rimmed building rings, near-black HUD backings, and a minimap frame that stands off its panel more. The RTS shows no sky or specular, so only tone, depth and grounding are judged against L9. The new hint strip covers only floor/grid in every pose. Only survives has identifiable content under a BEFORE panel; there the core ring, left body and two small units stay identifiable on near-black. The cost is that lifting the floor compresses relative lightness on pale thin cues (mint bars, ring-edge pixel, orange build bar). Absolute separation and RGB distance rise, and I cannot see any whole bar, arc or infantry cue as fainter in the crops or native frames. I therefore record no confirmed cue regression, while leaving the watch open. The resolution pin gets no credit. The temporal exposure criterion is unverified.

limitations: Read-only and by eye. I opened four optional raws at native size: survives and build, run1, BEFORE and PINNED. Performance and the other poses rest on the sheets plus leaf raw reads, so thin 3px bars and 1px arcs there are partly second-hand. Static endpoint frames only. Exposure settling, pumping, flicker, adaptation, shimmer in motion, FPS and audio are NOT verified; matching repeats show endpoint repeatability only. No hostile units, order markers, damage or partial bar fills appear, so enemy colours and fill/track partial states are unassessed. Metrics are single-patch examples with no threshold. The bar-vs-pale-facet figure is my arithmetic on the supplied medians. Panel teal→near-black and the black hint box are the declared intent and were judged on legibility only. The performance and AI-attack PINNED frames are reused preflight frames. No benefit is attributed to the resolution pin.
